FORM GST DRC-01
Summary of Show Cause Notice
Reference No: ZD030726001234
Date: 12/07/2026

To: M/s Gupta Hosiery Mills, Ludhiana
GSTIN: 03AABCG1234H1Z5

Tax Period: April 2025 to June 2025
Section: 73 of the CGST Act, 2017

It is observed that Input Tax Credit of Rs. 18,00,000 was claimed
in GSTR-3B, whereas credit of only Rs. 14,00,000 is reflected in
GSTR-2B as reported by your suppliers.
The unmatched Input Tax Credit is Rs. 4,00,000.

Tax: Rs. 4,00,000
Interest: Rs. 72,000
Penalty: Rs. 40,000
Total: Rs. 5,12,000

You are hereby required to show cause and file a reply in FORM GST
DRC-06 on or before 14/08/2026, failing which the matter will be
decided ex-parte on the basis of records available.

obligation: GST show cause notice, form DRC-01. Reference ZD030726002891. Period October 2024 to December 2024. A separate demand from the 14 August 2026 one. The page puts the demand at Rs 2,04,800. We cannot stand behind that figure. One page it refers to is missing, and the interest is stated twice with two different numbers. Reply in form DRC-06 by 7 August 2026. We will not file until the figures are settled.
consequence:
7 August 2026: your window to reply closes
September 2026: order passed without hearing you
December 2026: appeal window shuts, needs a deposit of 10 percent of whatever the order confirms
After that: recovery. Bank account can be attached.

blockers.detail: This notice refers to Annexure-A. That page was not in what you uploaded. The amount may be incomplete.
We read two different interest figures from this page and cannot tell which is correct.
